# Provenance: catalogue-keys

- `orca.json`: OrcaSlicer@09aa0114b4e145b89cd61015d8cdf29dbc15b008 `src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp`, AGPL-3.0.
- `bambu.json`: BambuStudio@79df7ae309be398ed30c9f397c13c9911c2edc57 `src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp`, AGPL-3.0.
- `prusa.json`: PrusaSlicer@b028299c770b8380ee81c921a2867d522f288123 (2.9) `src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp`, AGPL-3.0.
- `prusa3.json`: PrusaSlicer@30ef59195e0f3ee6f270b185bb5f9fb5f349f81f (3.0 alpha) domain config definitions, AGPL-3.0.
- `superslicer.json`: SuperSlicer@1f3d287e9be46caa83bc19c16c51c8abd0c211d6 `src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp`, AGPL-3.0.
- `cura.json`: Cura@5bea2f86153faed3a1c2d9081b8d6b753684678a `resources/definitions/fdmprinter.def.json`, `fdmextruder.def.json`, LGPL-3.0.
